verdict.rationale: Voice cloning is a fair question for a voice AI agent platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows choosing from existing voices, accents and styles, plus support for TTS providers such as ElevenLabs. There is no documented first-party voice cloning and no consent process; the 'clone' mentions refer to agent templates, not voices.

support.subject: As a founder, I can clone a custom brand voice and use it for my agents, with a documented consent process
